title: Snort or Suricata: Choosing an Open-Source IDS/IPS
excerpt: Two leading open-source intrusion detection and prevention engines. Snort has the longest history and largest community; Suricata was designed from the start for multi-threaded performance and broad protocol parsing.
verdict: Snort remains a strong choice with a huge community and plenty of learning material, and Snort 3 added multi-threaded packet processing. Suricata is often the better fit for high-throughput networks on modern multi-core hardware and for teams that want rich protocol logging built in.
